change_summary: Adds the FEDAI Rules as updated to 5 April 2024, from FEDAI's own circular: hours of business and holidays, export bills and crystallisation, the normal transit period, collections and remittances, import bills, contracts and delivery dates, early delivery, extension and cancellation, brokers and inter-bank settlement.
owner_decision: On 11 Nov 2026 the owner accepted publication on the agent's review alone, without a human reviewer.

held_back.reason: Restates the FEMA definition of foreign exchange as the courseware quotes it. The Act could not be retrieved from India Code to confirm the clause and sub-clauses, and a search result suggests the Act lists more sub-clauses than the courseware quotes.

The commercial standby safeguards for imports (courseware printed pp. 111-112) rest on older RBI circulars and on authorised dealers' guarantee powers; the current RBI Import Master Direction does not contain them and the guarantees Master Direction was not retrieved.
The question on the commercial standby safeguards rests on the same unverified RBI rules.

The trade credit amount and all-in-cost ceilings are in the Master Direction on External Commercial Borrowings, Trade Credits and Structured Obligations, which was not retrieved, and moved with the LIBOR transition.
The question on the trade credit ceiling rests on the same unverified figures.
The FDI and FPI definitions, 10 per cent threshold and closed-sector list rest on the Non-Debt Instruments Rules and the FDI Policy, which could not be retrieved; the courseware is the only source.
